page_objective: Define the visual structure, annotation behavior, interaction rules, readability standards, and responsive presentation system for SIPANEL technical diagrams, shop drawings, façade details, ZIP roofing systems, aluminum cladding systems, and industrial envelope engineering visuals.

diagram_philosophy.statement: Technical diagrams should transform complex engineering and envelope-system information into structured, readable, and trustworthy visual explanations.

diagram_system_goals.description: Help users quickly understand roofing, cladding, envelope coordination, waterproofing, drainage, thermal movement, and installation logic.
Show real engineering capability through structured technical visuals across sandwich panels, aluminum cladding, ZIP roofing, and industrial envelope systems.
Reduce confusion in RFQ, execution, envelope coordination, façade detailing, and project implementation.
Visually position SIPANEL as an industrial envelope engineering partner rather than a sandwich-panel-only contractor.

waterproofing_detail.purpose: Explain drainage paths, sealing, overlaps, and waterproofing risk reduction.

installation_sequence.purpose: Show structured installation flow and assembly logic.

technical_cutaway.purpose: Visualize hidden system layers and engineering relationships.

material_optimization_diagram.purpose: Explain waste reduction and material efficiency.

aluminum_cladding_detail.purpose: Explain ACP façade systems, cladding attachment methods, rainscreen logic, and façade coordination.

standing_seam_roof_detail.purpose: Explain ZIP roofing systems, standing seam joints, concealed fastening, and thermal movement control.

envelope_transition_detail.purpose: Visualize roof-to-façade transitions, parapet conditions, thermal continuity, and mixed-system coordination.

thermal_bridge_diagram.purpose: Explain thermal transfer conditions, insulation continuity, and thermal bridge mitigation.

façade_substructure_diagram.purpose: Explain bracket systems, alignment tolerances, façade anchoring, and structural coordination.

rules: Use neutral backgrounds for façade and standing seam section clarity.

spacing_rules: Separate structural and waterproofing annotations visually.
Preserve clear visual hierarchy between roofing and cladding systems.

annotation_rules: Use orange only for critical emphasis.
Separate thermal, airflow, and waterproofing annotations visually.
Use directional indicators for façade ventilation and standing seam expansion.

rules: Labels must remain readable at all zoom levels.
Preserve contrast on dark and light diagrams.
Use standardized terminology for façade, ZIP roofing, sandwich panel, and envelope systems.
Keep ACP, ZIP, BOM, MTO, and RFQ abbreviations consistent.
Use system-specific previews for façade, roofing, and transition diagrams.
Preserve critical technical callouts in previews.
Keep close button visible at all zoom levels.
Prioritize transition details and critical movement indicators.
Use progressive detail disclosure for complex diagrams.
Enable expanded view for dense content.
Support medium-density façade and roofing details.
Allow simultaneous diagram and annotation inspection.

forbidden_content: Overly decorative architectural renders without engineering explanation

rules: Do not rely only on color for technical explanation.
Use diagrams to explain engineering value.
Support technical visuals with concise explanation.
Support ZIP roofing movement explanation visually.
Use transition diagrams for envelope continuity storytelling.
Use annotations to explain engineering reasoning rather than decoration.

requirements: Do not rely on color alone.
Provide accessible summaries for façade and roofing diagrams.
Support keyboard navigation in fullscreen viewer.

rules: Keep measurements and units consistent globally.
Validate engineering terminology across all languages.
Preserve diagram readability after RTL mirroring.

implementation_notes: Technical diagrams are a core SIPANEL trust-building mechanism and must remain highly readable.
All engineering visuals should balance technical depth with user comprehension.
Mobile interaction and fullscreen zoom support are mandatory.
Diagram systems should integrate directly with the SIPANEL technical storytelling framework.
Diagram systems must support sandwich panels, aluminum cladding, ZIP roofing, façade engineering, and industrial envelope coordination equally.
Technical visualization should reinforce SIPANEL as an industrial envelope engineering authority.
